record.name: Human
record.description: Adaptable and ambitious, Humans are found in every corner of the galaxy, shaping trade routes, politics, and the destinies of worlds.

innate_traits.name: Adaptable
innate_traits.narrative: Your species' incredible adaptability allows you to quickly learn and master new skills, making you capable of excelling in any role or environment.

innate_traits.name: Broad Experience
innate_traits.narrative: Your species' diverse experiences across the galaxy have given you a broad foundation of knowledge that you can draw upon in unfamiliar situations.

mechanics.name: Background Knowledge
mechanics.description: Once per short rest, you can gain advantage on a skill check that reflects your background or past experiences.

innate_traits.name: Cultural Fluency
innate_traits.narrative: Your species' widespread presence across the galaxy has given you an innate ability to learn and adapt to different cultures and languages.

appearance_profile.llm_description_prompt: Describe a Human character. Emphasize their adaptability and the way their appearance reflects their background, culture, and experiences. Consider their heritage, profession, and the environment they've adapted to. Their clothing and mannerisms should tell the story of where they come from and what they've experienced in the galaxy.

class_synergies.narrative: Humans' adaptability and broad experience make them capable of excelling in any class, quickly learning and adapting to new roles and challenges.
mechanical_benefits: Adaptable trait allows skill proficiency in any area
Broad Experience provides flexibility in unfamiliar situations
Cultural Fluency aids in communication and integration

class_synergies.narrative: Humans' strong sense of duty and protective instincts make them natural Guardians, willing to defend others and adapt their fighting style to any situation.
mechanical_benefits: Adaptable trait allows Guardian to learn defensive techniques quickly
Broad Experience aids in protecting against various threats
Natural leadership abilities enhance Guardian's protective role

class_synergies.narrative: Humans' adaptability and cultural fluency make them excellent Scoundrels, able to blend into any environment and manipulate situations to their advantage.
mechanical_benefits: Cultural Fluency aids in deception and social manipulation
Adaptable trait supports various criminal activities
Broad Experience helps navigate complex social situations

class_synergies.narrative: Humans' natural curiosity and adaptability make them excellent Scholars, able to learn and synthesize knowledge from diverse sources.
mechanical_benefits: Cultural Fluency aids in research and communication
Adaptable trait supports learning new fields of study
Broad Experience provides context for academic pursuits

faction_synergies.narrative: Humans have been central to the Republic's governance and military, with their adaptability making them effective administrators and soldiers.
Humans form the backbone of the Rebellion, their adaptability and determination making them effective resistance fighters and leaders.
Many humans serve in the Imperial military, their organizational skills and adaptability making them effective officers and soldiers.
Humans can be found throughout the galaxy, adapting to local cultures and forming their own communities and organizations.

species_progression.base_description: Your species' incredible adaptability allows you to quickly learn and master new skills, making you capable of excelling in any role or environment.

level_5.description: Your adaptability has grown more sophisticated. You can learn new skills more quickly and adapt to changing situations with greater ease.

level_10.description: Your adaptability has become legendary. You can quickly master any skill or technique you observe.

mechanical_effect.description: Once per long rest, you can gain proficiency in any skill you witness being used successfully

level_15.description: You have become a master of adaptation. Your ability to learn and adapt is unparalleled.

mechanical_effect.description: Once per long rest, you can temporarily gain expertise in any skill for 1 hour

level_20.description: You are a living legend of adaptability. Your ability to learn and adapt transcends normal limitations.

mechanical_effect.description: Once per long rest, you can gain mastery of any skill or technique for 1 minute

cultural_features.name: Galactic Citizen
cultural_features.description: Your deep connection to the diverse cultures and communities across the galaxy.
cultural_features.activation: When interacting with different cultures or adapting to new social situations
cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: You can seamlessly adapt to any cultural context, understanding and respecting different traditions and customs.

cultural_features.name: Versatile Expertise
cultural_features.description: Your species' natural ability to develop expertise in multiple fields and adapt to different roles.
cultural_features.activation: When switching between different roles or applying knowledge from one field to another
cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: You can apply knowledge and skills from one area to solve problems in another, your versatility making you a valuable asset in any situation.

cultural_features.name: Resilient Spirit
cultural_features.description: Your species' incredible resilience and determination in the face of adversity.
cultural_features.activation: When facing challenges or overcoming obstacles
cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: You can draw upon your species' incredible resilience, finding strength and determination even in the most difficult circumstances.

cultural_features.name: Innovative Thinking
cultural_features.description: Your species' natural creativity and ability to find innovative solutions to problems.
cultural_features.activation: When solving complex problems or creating new solutions
cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: You can think outside the box and find creative solutions to problems that others might consider impossible.

environmental_adaptations.advantage: Natural expertise in urban environments and social navigation
environmental_adaptations.immersion_effect: You move through urban environments with natural ease, your species' evolutionary adaptation to city life making you perfectly at home in crowded streets and bustling markets.

environmental_adaptations.advantage: Enhanced comfort and performance in space environments
environmental_adaptations.immersion_effect: Your species' natural affinity for space travel and exploration makes you feel at home in the void, understanding ship systems and space environments instinctively.

environmental_adaptations.advantage: Enhanced ability to adapt to and navigate diverse cultural environments
environmental_adaptations.immersion_effect: Your natural understanding of diverse cultures allows you to navigate complex social landscapes and adapt to different cultural contexts with ease.

environmental_adaptations.advantage: Enhanced ability to adapt to rapidly changing conditions and environments
environmental_adaptations.immersion_effect: Your species' incredible adaptability allows you to quickly adjust to changing conditions, making you perfectly suited for dynamic and unpredictable environments.

services.name: Galactic Advisor
services.description: As a skilled diplomat and strategist, this AI provides expert guidance on navigating the complexities of intergalactic politics.

record.flavor_text: Humans have always been a species of unyielding resilience, forging civilizations from the ashes of war-torn worlds. From the ancient colonies on Coruscant to the sprawling metropolises of Corellia, their capacity for adaptability and innovation has left an indelible mark on the galaxy. Yet, amidst their triumphs, lies a thread of hubris - a tendency to overextend themselves, courting the very destruction they seek to prevent.

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: As a Human, you embody the species' inherent drive for self-improvement and progress. Your actions are guided by an insatiable curiosity about the workings of the universe, often leading you down paths of discovery that challenge conventional wisdom. Be mindful of your tendency to prioritize individual ambition over collective well-being.
narrative_hooks: The scars of past wars still linger on Coruscant, and the memory of the Great Hyperspace War continues to shape Human politics.
As a skilled diplomat, you find yourself at odds with the isolationist tendencies of the Human colonists on Tatooine.
llm_guidance.social_dynamics: Humans tend to form close-knit communities based on shared interests or values. They often seek out mentors or role models within their social circles and are fiercely loyal to those who have helped them grow.
common_motivations: Exploring the mysteries of the Force
